summary: Backend-only testing for NFT gate + global league features. Wrote and executed 17 pytest cases covering /api/nft/status, /api/auth/connect gating & bypass, forged-JWT NFT enforcement on authed endpoints, /api/global/opponent (no self), /api/matches mode=global (draw mirrors both stats, self-opponent treated as bot, null-address bot), /api/global/matches, /api/global/me form, /api/leaderboard ordering + goal_diff, quick+league modes still work, invalid mode -> 422. All 17 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: current_user() calls require_nft on every authed request; per-address cache (120s) mitigates RPC pressure, but if RPC fails, all authed endpoints 503. Consider soft-fail for cached bypass or graceful degradation.

save_match global path: opponent stat mirroring uses stat_inc(og, pg) which correctly swaps outcome, but does NOT verify rival wallet actually owns NFT before crediting them stats - acceptable per spec (rival is existing user).
global_opponent picks least-recently-faced by scanning last 50 home matches only; away-side matches by user are ignored so 'faced' list is incomplete.
server.py is 502 lines and mixes many concerns; consider splitting into auth/league/global modules.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projection {'_id':0} - good.
